hints.title: Progressive Interval Scheduling
hints.text: Manage recurring invocations whose spacing scales linearly with cycle count, maintaining cancellation tokens.

hints.title: Recursive Timeout Dispatch
hints.text: Schedule subsequent timeouts inside each execution cycle with delay formula delay plus period times count, storing active timer handles.

hints.title: Custom Interval Blueprint
hints.text: Increment unique token ID. In recursive helper, schedule setTimeout with delay + period * count, and provide customClearInterval to clear timeout.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: K: number of active custom interval instances
complexity.notes: Scheduling and cancellation operate in constant time per event.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard setInterval accepts only fixed periods and cannot dynamically adjust delays between iterations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains mapping between interval identifier and current active timer ID.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of recursive timeout chaining with cleanup map to cancel future executions cleanly.
